cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Not Until You Explain
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until they account for one contradiction, omission, or suspicious change in their story.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Wait before you go. You said our wedding venue was booked for Friday. This says Monday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Monday was cheaper. Can you sign? I'm late for work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Stay while I read it. You told me Friday was confirmed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It was. I moved it after we sent the invitations.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then work needs to wait. Explain when you planned to tell the Friday guests.

mechanism: A withholds approval of a document and departure until B accounts for a concealed wedding-date change.
confusable: Unlike objecting to the price decision, A demands the missing explanation about guests and controls when B may leave.
comparison: Wedding invitations and lateness to work differ from a missing hour and offered lift.
seedUse: The seed already denies quick signature and postpones work; S01 strengthens those concrete permissions.
